note: The bands the Slow Stick plant has to land in, from docs/SLOWSTICK-STAGE1.md, which derives each from published figures for the GWS Slow Stick, GWS's power table and the drawn model (scripts/slowstick-derive.js prints the derived figures). Each band is the Cub's in proportion about its derived figure unless its source says otherwise. Never widened to pass; argue in the derivation instead.

s1_level_75.source: level speed at 75 percent throttle, derived 5.58: the Slow Stick's cruise

s2_stall.source: sqrt(2W / rho S CLmax), derived 4.43; alphaStall is CLmax / CLalpha, 1.05 / 4.58, of the zero lift line

s4_top.source: level speed at full throttle, derived 8.37

s5_climb.source: full throttle, best over a sweep of airspeeds, derived 1.17 at 5.0 m/s

s6_self_level.source: from a 30 deg bank at cruise, every stick centred: the four state lateral model gives 20.8, 16.3 and 12.9 deg after 2, 4 and 6 s, a spiral that halves the bank in 5.8 s; the bank at 6 s, the same side, and never steeper than it started

s7_rudder_bank.source: full right roll stick, which is full right rudder, from level cruise: 32.9 deg after 1 s by the lateral model, right wing down

s8_turn.source: a level 45 deg bank held on the rudder at 90 percent: the radius against V^2 / (g tan bank) at the bank and speed flown, the Cub's 15 percent, and the radius itself against the 4.66 m the level turn flies at 6.76 m/s with 6.9 deg of up elevator, the turn's pitch damping included, within the same 15 percent. 75 percent will not hold a level 45 deg bank.

s9_stall_power_off.source: full up from cruise, throttle closed, held 8 s: the pitching moment, taken back through the stall, trims at 17.9 deg of alpha and the aircraft settles into a mush at 5.7 m/s sinking 2.09 m/s, within 25 percent; no wing drop, no yaw that is a spin (a spin at this size turns at over 90 deg/s), the nose never plunging

s9_stall_power_on.source: the same with the throttle left at cruise: no wing drop, no spin, no plunge; the prop's torque and P factor turn it slowly, which is not a departure

s10_phugoid.source: the phugoid root of the four state longitudinal model trimmed at the 5.58 m/s cruise, derived 6.08

s11_prop_torque.source: static full throttle, rolling left: ideal disc power 0.033, GWS's electrical figure through a geared can motor 0.057

s12_chop.source: throttle off from cruise, pitch stick neutral: a glide, not a tumble

s13_throw.source: a throw at 6 m/s and cruise throttle with every stick centred, the elevator trimmed for 5.5 m/s: flying level after three seconds, not sinking out of the hand

s14_rest.source: the drawn model at rest, 6.91 deg and 0.1349 m, 25.8 percent on the tail

s15_takeoff.source: full throttle on grass with every stick centred, from standing: derived 4.9 m and 5.2 m/s, the wing near its stall at the rest attitude

s16_landing.source: a glide from 3 m at cruise, flared at half a metre: touches at a jog, 1.1 V_s is 4.9 m/s, and comes to rest on three wheels at S14's attitude, no hull

s17_unmoved.source: the five inch's canonical replay hash, the wing's, the Skyhunter's, the Cub's, the Radian's and the Bramor's two recorded flight hashes in Node, all from before the Slow Stick existed (the Radian's and the Bramor's from main's module at be91597). Re-recorded for crash round 4 aero (#59), from its merged build, with the owner's sign-off on the stall after flying it: sky, cub, glider, bramor, bramorChute each cross the stall (docs/STALL-STAGE1.md, npm run stall:crossing); the five inch, the wing and the Slow Stick are unchanged The Radian's re-recorded again for crash round 5 on the lead's decision to take its 6 deg FITTED washout (docs/STALL-STAGE1.md), not on an owner's flight: its recording first differs at 7.778 s, in the stall (npm run stall:crossing). Every recorded flight re-recorded again for aero round 6's fix, the table's rotary derivatives applied in the stability axes, one commit per recording from that build: each moves short of the stall as well (docs/STALL-STAGE1.md, Round 6).

s19_thermal.source: a straight pass at cruise through the core of the strongest thermal (2.5 m/s, 45 m, plant_wing.c), pitch stick centred: the aircraft rises with the air, w0 (16/15) R / V = 21.5 m, against the same flight in still air; the band is 25 percent, the phugoid and the speed the pass is flown at

s18_cross_host.source: the Slow Stick's recorded take off and flight, state trace hash, Node against headless Chrome
